description: We are a team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, passionate about AI, data analysis, software development, and space exploration. We aim to solve real-world challenges through creativity and teamwork. We welcome motivated members with skills in AI/ML, programming, data science, design, and presentation who are eager to learn and build an impactful project together.
summary:
​SpaceVital is an intelligent, real-time astronaut health monitoring and autonomous emergency response platform built for deep-space missions. During long-duration spaceflight, communication delays with Earth make immediate medical intervention impossible, putting crew members at high risk during sudden physiological emergencies or radiation spikes.
​To address this challenge, SpaceVital continuously tracks critical biomedical telemetry—including heart rate, SpO2, core body temperature, and radiation exposure—integrating experimental Machine Learning models to detect early anomalies and classify multi-level warning states. In critical scenarios, the system automatically triggers localized audio alerts and records tamper-proof incident logs inside a cryptographically secured Emergency Black Box using SHA-256 hashing.
​By combining real-time diagnostics, predictive analytics, and offline-capable emergency logging, SpaceVital empowers space crews with autonomous medical decision support, significantly enhancing survival rates and mission safety beyond Earth's orbit.

​SpaceVital is an intelligent, real-time astronaut health monitoring and autonomous emergency response platform built for deep-space missions. ​To address this challenge, SpaceVital continuously tracks critical biomedical telemetry—including heart rate, SpO2, core body temperature, and radiation exposure—integrating experimental Machine Learning models to detect early anomalies and classify multi-level warning states. In critical scenarios, the system automatically triggers localized audio alerts and records tamper-proof incident logs inside a cryptographically secured Emergency Black Box using SHA-256 hashing.

​By combining real-time diagnostics, predictive analytics, and offline-capable emergency logging, SpaceVital empowers space crews with autonomous medical decision support, significantly enhancing survival rates and mission safety beyond Earth's orbit

Tools & Technologies Used:

SpaceVital was developed using Python and the Streamlit framework, featuring a custom responsive Glassmorphism UI built with CSS and deployed on Streamlit Community Cloud. Data processing, visualization, and anomaly detection are powered by Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Scikit-learn, while real-time orbital telemetry is fetched via live API requests. System integrity and emergency response rely on SQLite3 with SHA-256 cryptographic hashing (Hashlib), gTTS for automated voice alerts, and FPDF2 for medical reporting.
